task: BRACS RoI N versus IC, not comprehensive breast diagnosis
image_processing: RGB resize 768x768, fixed 8x8 grid of 96px patches; original MPP unknown, domain/scale mismatch disclosed
selection: highest validation ensemble balanced accuracy; tie favors mean_mlp
ensemble: mean probability across all three seeds; threshold 0.5 fixed
test: selected architecture only; no tuning after test; one image per patient
scope: expanded size-biased binary pilot, distinct new-patient test; not comparable head-to-head with old test
custom_patient_split: 22 previously unacquired patients reserved; original validation patients retained; historical test may be training now
selection_of_roi: smallest available N/IC image per patient, including mixed-label patients; label is regional
